description: Does a reader whose own Workspace has an open level see another Workspace's later commit, through a dynaset opened before and through new snapshots, and after its own level ends? Owner A = Workspaces(0) with DBEngine.OpenDatabase(main, writable); owner B = DBEngine.CreateWorkspace('second', dbUseJet) with its own OpenDatabase(main, writable); one STA. B opens dynaset rsd on Wide rows 1, 2 and 64; B: BeginTrans; read Wide through a new snapshot. A: BeginTrans; UPDATE Wide SET V = 100 WHERE ID = 1 (dbFailOnError); CommitTrans; DBEngine.Errors. B: new snapshot; rsd MoveFirst and read all; B Rollback; DBEngine.Errors; new snapshot; rsd MoveFirst and read all; rsd Requery and read all. Close; read Wide through a fresh Workspace.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
